title: Expose federation transport quarantine and explicit reconciliation
outcome: Give operators a redacted view of runtime transport quarantine and a reconciliation path that never permits a replacement SSH child before exact prior cleanup is proven.
acceptance: A redacted runtime view exposes each quarantined peer and its typed reason without capability, credential reference, or SSH output.

Explicit reconciliation permits a successor only after exact prior OS-operation/process cleanup is proven; stale enrollment or generation requests cannot clear a newer quarantine, and admission, reservations and uncertain outcomes are unchanged.
Regression controls prove unresolved cleanup remains fenced and exact resolved cleanup permits recovery; exact-input focused/full gate and independent pair accompany the fix.
